title: Spyglass: Unleash Deeper Insights
summary: We're thrilled to announce Spyglass has officially launched, providing powerful new capabilities to help you uncover critical information and gain unprecedented clarity.

title: Enhanced File Management for Your Content
summary: We've launched powerful new tools, allowing you to easily manage, upload, and customize how images and documents appear directly within the editor, giving you greater control over your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past achievements, current developments, and future innovations.

title: Improved Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and visually consistent with your modern interface.

title: Smarter Collaborative Editing
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience when collaborating with your team, making shared work effortlessly efficient.

title: Smarter Sharing and Enhanced Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items from your connections, making teamwork more intuitive and productive than ever before.

title: Global Language Support for Noeko
summary: Noeko is now available in more languages, allowing users worldwide to experience its full potential.

title: Introducing Open Source Noeko
summary: Experience ultimate control and transparency as Noeko's full codebase becomes open source, inviting you to shape its incredible journey alongside us.

title: Smarter Knowledge Graph Exploration
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity, filtering by tags and time, and effortlessly collaborating with friends through integrated sharing features.

title: Refined Search & Dynamic Collections
summary: Discover a powerful new way to navigate your knowledge base, enabling you to apply precise filters, sort results, and save custom collections of your most relevant information.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Unlock a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts and information with dynamic content views that bring your linked notes, tasks, and sources to life.

title: Unlock Noeko's Full Potential: Self-Hosting and Enterprise Plans
summary: We're launching Noeko's self-hosting options and flexible paid plans, giving you ultimate control and access to powerful enterprise features.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Fresh Themes
summary: We're delivering a stunning collection of polished themes and exciting new options to personalize your Noeko experience.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Enjoy a more precise and personalized welcome with updated time-of-day greetings that accurately reflect your local time.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Experience a significant boost in productivity as you gain the power to manage multiple tagged items and remove tags directly from any list view.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly add and interact with diverse content like YouTube videos, websites, and text, centralizing all your essential information for a richer understanding.
